title: Exploration of Diagnostic Markers Associated with Inflammation in Chronic Kidney Disease Based on WGCNA and Machine Learning.
authors: Wu, Qianjia; Yang, Yang; Lin, Chongze
one_liner_zh: 基于WGCNA和机器学习筛选慢性肾病炎症相关诊断标志物，纯转录组表达分析与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模及AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a common disorder related to inflammatory pathways; its effective management remains limited. This study aimed to use bioinformatics analysis to find diagnostic markers that might be therapeutic targets for CKD. CKD microarray datasets were screened from the GEO database and the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in CKD dataset GSE98603 were analyzed. Gene set variation analysis (GSVA) was used to explore the activity scores of the inflammatory pathways and samples. Algorithms such as weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) and Lasso were used to screen CKD diagnostic markers related to inflammation. Then functional enrichment analysis of inflammation-related DEGs was performed. ROC curves were conducted to examine the diagnostic value of inflammation-related hub-genes. Lastly, quantitative real-time PCR further verified the prediction of bioinformatics. A total of 71 inflammation-related DEGs were obtained, of which 5 were hub genes. Enrichment analysis showed that these genes were significantly enriched in inflammation-related pathways (NF-kappaB, JAK-STAT, and MAPK signaling pathways). ROC curves showed that the 5 CKD diagnostic markers (TIGD7, ACTA2, ACTG2, MAP4K4, and HOXA11) also exhibited good diagnostic value. In addition, TIGD7, ACTA2, ACTG2, and HOXA11 expression was downregulated while MAP4K4 expression was upregulated in LPS-induced HK-2 cells. The present study identified TIGD7, ACTA2, ACTG2, MAP4K4, and HOXA11 as reliable CKD diagnostic markers, thereby providing a basis for further understanding of CKD in clinical treatments.
abstract_zh: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）是一种与炎症通路相关的常见疾病；其有效管理仍然有限。本研究旨在利用生物信息学分析寻找可能作为CKD治疗靶点的诊断标志物。从GEO数据库中筛选CKD微阵列数据集，并分析CKD数据集GSE98603中的差异表达基因（DEGs）。采用基因集变异分析（GSVA）探讨炎症通路和样本的活性评分。使用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和Lasso等算法筛选与炎症相关的CKD诊断标志物。随后对炎症相关DEGs进行功能富集分析。绘制ROC曲线以检验炎症相关核心基因的诊断价值。最后，实时定量PCR进一步验证了生物信息学的预测结果。共获得71个炎症相关DEGs，其中5个为核心基因。富集分析显示，这些基因显著富集于炎症相关通路（NF-kappaB、JAK-STAT和MAPK信号通路）。ROC曲线显示，5个CKD诊断标志物（TIGD7、ACTA2、ACTG2、MAP4K4和HOXA11）也表现出良好的诊断价值。此外，在LPS诱导的HK-2细胞中，TIGD7、ACTA2、ACTG2和HOXA11表达下调，而MAP4K4表达上调。本研究确定TIGD7、ACTA2、ACTG2、MAP4K4和HOXA11为可靠的CKD诊断标志物，从而为临床治疗中进一步理解CKD提供了基础。
